answer_1.quote: we generate triplets (head, relation, tail) that capture a wide range of semantic relationships

answer_4.quote: To evaluate the extent of the above-mentioned phenomena, we performed a human evaluation by submitting a sample of the generated triplets to an evaluator among the authors... Two of the authors and a non-expert graduate student were recruited for the evaluation.
answer_4.guideline: evaluators answered 8 multiple-choice questions per triplet: Grammaticality, Topical Similarity, Fatualness, Granularity, Originality, Uniqueness/diversity (relation), Uniqueness/diversity (head), Uniqueness/diversity (tail)
